title: kbroot.fetch_env keeps GIT_ASKPASS and SSH_ASKPASS, so a fetch can show a credential prompt
goal: kbroot.fetch_env drops GIT_ASKPASS and SSH_ASKPASS and git runs with core.askPass empty and the GCM non-interactive value the kb's fact names, so a fetch never prompts for a credential, and kb/_self/tools.md's kbroot row says only what the code does (SP-s2svf5a6 review gaps 5 and 13)

run:
import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
os.environ["GIT_ASKPASS"] = "/x/askpass"; os.environ["SSH_ASKPASS"] = "/x/askpass"
import kbroot
e = kbroot.fetch_env()
left = [k for k in ("GIT_ASKPASS", "SSH_ASKPASS") if e.get(k)]
print("askpass left in fetch_env:", left)
sys.exit(1 if left else 0)
